bundle.shortDescription: Cross-platform multi-protocol terminal — SSH/Telnet/Serial with SFTP, tunnels, snippets and login automation.
bundle.longDescription: ZAPX is a modern terminal client for network engineers and developers. SSH (password / public key / agent / 2FA) with ProxyJump and port forwarding, Telnet (RFC 854), Serial, SFTP browser, multi-exec broadcast, persistent snippets, automated login scripts, and a recursive split-pane workspace.
